content.short: bigpump is an AI-assisted NFTFi launch platform for creating, tokenizing, and trading NFT-backed assets.
content.description: bigpump is an NFTFi launch platform that combines AI-assisted asset creation, NFT tokenization, and bonding-curve trading. Creators can launch NFT projects with a simplified workflow, while the platform turns NFTs into tokenized assets with native liquidity and price discovery. The product includes creator verification, configurable trading fees, AI image generation, and a launch process designed to remove technical barriers for artists and communities. On Mantle, bigpump gives users a dedicated venue for NFT-backed issuance and trading with low-cost on-chain execution.
